_comment: TEMPLATE -- NOT DATA. Every value below is invented to show the shape; the leading
underscore keeps the loader from reading it. Copy it, rename it to the code, and
replace everything. See SCHEMA.md for the rules each field is under.
The one field to get right is correctiveActions[].appliedAt: it is the entire basis
of the Post-CA verdict, and no verdict is computable without it.

rootCauses.statement: One or two sentences saying what actually causes this, specific enough that somebody who has never seen it could recognise it on the floor.

evidence.quote: What they actually wrote. Quote or paraphrase; never infer.

correctiveActions.action: What was changed, in the imperative, specific enough to repeat.
